non_authorization_and_limits: This file is a static proposal only. It does not freeze a protocol or authorize preparation/build/execution.
No outputQDQ is added and weight scale is never reused as an activation/output scale.
Removing a QDQ path deliberately changes mathematical semantics and compiler-format context; it is a diagnosis, not a quantization-equivalent repair.
No parserreset, fullmodel retry, newscale calibration, changed thresholds/tolerances, dataset, accuracy, causal target recovery or performance claim.
